periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonally oriented at approximately 45 degrees downward towards the rostrum relative to the facial midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval, with the longitudinal axis significantly exceeding the transverse width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering toward the muzzle, extending the patch below the central eye position.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shape curve along the posterior boundary of the band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The band is broad, occupying approximately 30-35% of the visible dorsal area from neck to mid-back.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation approximately equivalent to the width of the pinna itself.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Highly smooth, convex curvature at the top of the ear boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Notable color gradient between the bright white facial pelage and the yellowish-cream hue of the dorsal fur.
